renderings.bsb: of her who had grown old
renderings.kjv: I unto her that was old

elsewhere.note: they also resorted to a ruse, and went and made as if they had been ambassadors, and took old sacks on their donkeys, and old, torn-up and bound up wine skins,
Then I said of her who was old in adulteries, ‘Now they will play the prostitute with her, and she with them.’
